content.title: When Does 'The Pitt' Season 2 Episode 10 Come Out? How and Where to Watch
content.text: The mass casualty approaches.Mar 12, 2026 8:00 AM EDTNoah Wyle as Dr. Robby on ‘The Pitt.’ Photograph by Warrick Page/HBO MaxKey PointsThe Pitt's staff faces a mass casualty incident after a waterslide collapse at an amusement park.Doctors face chaos as the wade through analog charts amid ongoing cyber attack threats.Season 2, Episode 10 streams on HBO Max March 12, with weekly Thursday releases. The Pitt is taking some inspiration from 9-1-1: Nashville with this season’s mass casualty incident as the staff at Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Center brace for even more patients to be rushed to the emergency room after a waterslide collapsed at a local amusement park. Of course there’s concern for the kid who was on the slide at the time, but think about whoever was under it, and all of the slips, trips, stumbles and falls of the crowd running from the point of disaster on wet concrete. We’re likely to see tramplings, drownings, head traumas, broken limbs and more, all while the doctors continue to fumble with their analog charts and inaccessible technologies following the threat of a cyber attack. Eventually, the only way to go will be up…the question is simply when. Here’s everything to know about tonight’s new episode of The Pitt Season 2. Season 2, Episode 10 of The Pitt is available to stream on HBO Max starting on Thursday, March 12 at 9:00 p.m. ET/6:00 p.m. PT. What time does The Pitt Season 2, Episode 10 air tonight? New episodes of The Pitt become available each week at 9:00 p.m. ET/6:00 p.m. PT on Thursdays on HBO Max. What will happen in The Pitt Season 2, Episode 10 tonight? As we patiently wait to see what Roxie’s fate will be after Dr. Robby’s (Noah Wyle) most recent suggested plan of treatment toed the line of breaking the law and Dr. King’s (Taylor Dearden) sister, Becca (Tal Anderson), receives treatment for an apparent UTI from Dr. Langdon (Patrick Ball) while Mel sits through her deposition, traumas head in from the water park, with everyone standing by to jump in—except, it seems, for Dr. Mohan (Supriya Ganesh), who appears to come down with a sudden illness in the middle of the shift, as hinted in the official trailer. What is The Pitt Season 2 release schedule? Here is the release schedule for the rest of The Pitt Season 2.
